prompt: Create one photorealistic fictional adult woman character reference image for Bittertalen, a Dutch language learning app built around Dutch art and culture. This is Saskia, about 38 years old, the friendly owner of a small cafe inside a Dutch art museum. She must feel like a real approachable acquaintance, not an advertising model. Medium dark-blond hair to her shoulders, gently wavy, casually tucked behind her ears; grey-green eyes, expressive eyebrows, a warm soft closed-mouth smile, fine natural smile lines at the eyes. Real skin texture and pores, minimal makeup, small simple silver earrings. Cobalt blue cotton shirt with casually rolled sleeves, dark navy apron with a tiny round orange bitterbal lapel pin; the pin has no text. Natural relaxed posture, direct attentive eye contact with viewer. Waist-up framing, both shoulders and BOTH hands fully visible resting comfortably on a simple cafe table, ready for conversational gestures, no hands covering face. Camera at eye level, natural 50mm documentary portrait. In the softly blurred background: a bright modest museum cafe with one framed reproduction of a Dutch Golden Age landscape painting, a small white-and-cobalt Delft ceramic vase, daylight through tall windows with an understated Dutch canal street beyond. Restrained palette: tin-glaze white, cobalt blue, natural wood and one tiny orange accent. No beige design wash, no visible written text, no logos, no captions, no multiple panels, no additional people. Balanced soft daylight, face evenly lit, unobstructed jawline. Portrait 3:4. Preserve realistic ordinary proportions and asymmetry, not glamour, no airbrushing, no doll/plush/cartoon/3D look. The resulting still is the canonical identity reference for a future human video avatar; it must not depict motion or open-mouth speech.
